answer: That closes the loop where an operator edits the ledger and answers against its own edit in the same window, which burns it the epoch. Because the horizon height is fixed at intake and published in the kernel receipt, the pigment audit and the replay can prove which state the answer was judged against. Answers are graded against a checkpoint at least 234 seconds old, so a submission cannot be scored against state it just changed itself. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
